encounters.title: The Mirrored Casualty
encounters.description: Your scout team enters a collapsed subway tunnel. Pinned beneath a concrete slab is a frozen corpse. Upon rolling the body over, the scout realizes the corpse is wearing their exact hazard suit, bearing their exact serial number, and features a custom boot-repair the scout performed yesterday. The corpse's geiger counter is ticking backwards.

outcomes.success_text: The scout stripped the gear from their own corpse with cold detachment. The inventory ledger shows a +1 surplus in hazard suits. The paradox was not documented on the official form.
outcomes.failure_text: While unbuckling the helmet, the corpse's eyes opened. The scout fled in terror, abandoning half their gear in the tunnel.

outcomes.success_text: Protocol 7 dictates that all temporal anomalies be purged. The scout burned the corpse using three days worth of kerosene, returning empty-handed but sane.

encounters.title: The Metric Forest
encounters.description: The expedition crosses into a sector of petrified woods. Every tree is spaced in a perfect, equidistant 2.0-meter grid. The branches grow at precise 90-degree angles. When a scout chops into a trunk for firewood, it bleeds warm, pressurized hydraulic fluid instead of sap.

outcomes.success_text: The team tapped the trees like maples, draining 40 liters of high-grade machine lubricant. The forest remained perfectly, silently still as they bled it dry.
outcomes.failure_text: As the third tree was tapped, the grid shifted. The trees physically moved, closing in and crushing the scout team in a geometrically perfect square.
